_about: Module definitions for the excavation group. See logistics.json for the shape. `front` is the way the cutter digs.

modules.name: Cutter Excavator
modules.blurb: Cuts a 30-wide tunnel in soft ground ahead of it (Drill Bit research hardens it: Clay and Stone later) and passes what it digs to the Tank above. Needs power, and a Winch to hang from.
